summary: Froggy Finale is a 90-second rhythm concert where the bouncing frog is your metronome — notes are PERFECT only when hit on the exact frame he lands on his drum, building dance combos, rainbow streaks, and the big finale leap, while a miss makes him slip and mirrors the lanes for 4 beats. Play with Enter to start, A/K for the guitar lane, S/L for the drum lane, both together for beamed pairs, hold the big notes, and press Space for glowing stomp beats — survive to "BRAVO! What A Dance!" without missing 8 notes or the crowd goes quiet.
